title: Order Ingestion
description: Orders flow in from your storefront, marketplace, or ERP via API or connector.

title: Smart Carrier Allocation
description: The allocation engine scores every eligible carrier and assigns the best match.

title: Label & Manifest Generation
description: Shipping labels and carrier manifests are generated automatically.

title: Pickup Scheduling
description: Pickup requests are scheduled with the assigned carrier for your warehouse.

title: In-Transit Tracking
description: Every shipment status update is normalized into one tracking timeline.

title: NDR & Exception Management
description: Failed delivery attempts and exceptions surface for action before they become RTOs.

title: Delivery Confirmation
description: Proof of delivery is captured and synced back to your system.

title: Reverse Pickup
description: Return and exchange pickups are scheduled automatically when triggered.

title: Analytics & Reconciliation
description: Cost, performance, and COD reconciliation data roll up into reporting.
